execution.description: Bounded read-only public Git/PR history capture for eleven cohorts and ten preparation milestones, with native metrics and onboarding diagnostics.

expected: Cover 110 milestones with immutable source/PR bases, honest effort unknowns and three recurring-delay candidates, without solver/cloud execution or private case reads.
observed: All 110 public source observations resolved after stale readiness-input paths were replaced by per-family public registry entry history and the f13 budget source corrected. One shared verification-spec commit had appeared as three replications: event deduplication removed that false bottleneck. Corrected recurring median arrival gaps: packet 25.69h (3 events), question law 24.29h (5), panel 19.60h (4). Historical accepted-stage elapsed and person-hours are unrecorded. Metrics fixtures passed; combined onboarding diagnostics initially reported 50/52, then 51/52 because sparse checkout omitted public cited docs, not because authority/tests should be weakened; restore exact public references before the final rerun. Native output is diagnostic, not canonical acceptance.
keep: Separate source revision, first publication, accepted stage exit and active effort.
Use explicit public source pins and exact merge identities; report open PRs as censored.
Deduplicate shared delivery events and activity proxies without inventing FTE or labour savings.
change: Validate source inventory before ranking: a missing planned input is not missing implementation history.
Use selected public readiness-entry history, not a shared registry's creation date for every family.
Capture future active-duration records with provenance and one allocation for shared work; keep historical effort UNKNOWN.
